title: Repair Management portfolio reads and login session responsiveness

source_fixes.summary: Include preferred_username and name claims from the configured test_admin client_id (admintest) on /bff/auth/login and /bff/auth/dev-login so /bff/me exposes display_name=admintest while preserving stable audit subject sub=pantheon-dev-admin-test and all 6 roles.

Accept risk_policy_ref: Optional[str] = None in CapitalPoolPort.list_capital_pools, PersonaCapitalRuntimeDomainPort.list_capital_pools, and ReadSurfacePorts.list_capital_pools, filtering by risk_policy_ref/risk_policy_id so GET /bff/management/portfolio-book returns live owner data without TypeError (500) and honors risk policy filters.

Offload synchronous urllib provider list, provider readiness, and provider usage-summary calls via asyncio.to_thread(copy_context().run, ...) so simultaneous /bff/auth/readiness, /bff/me, and /bff/auth/logout remain responsive (<80ms) while providers?auth_probe=true or providers/usage-summary?auth_probe=true runs.

Configure OPENCLAW_PRIMARY_MODEL=openai/gpt-5.6-sol for Management AI (agent_id=main) in openclaw-gateway-adapter without changing global/held agents (agents.defaults.model.primary=anthropic/claude-opus-4-8, persona-opinion-*, or structured-extraction), surface active_model on stream done events, and keep readiness(auth_probe=True) stateless (operator_id=None, session_id=None) so repeated probes do not collide on a shared warm Gateway session lane.

Verify the expected provider auth file (auth.json for codex, .credentials.json for claude) exists as a regular file inside the mount before reporting ready or wrong_owner, so empty mount directories truthfully report status=missing_credentials and owner_check=not_checked regardless of directory ownership.
